column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Evidently, on a little island called the Free Alliance States, they practice some very peculiar form of government called "democracy..."
column5: 自由同盟国という小さな島では、「民主制」とかいう、実に奇妙な政治の形を実践しているらしい……

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The Free DragonKing F'Lar may not be as bad as Rhegar, but he sure has a thing about gouging people...
column5: 自由ドラゴン王フラーはレイガーほど悪辣ではないかもしれないが、人から金をむしり取るのが大好きなのは間違いない……

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The Free Troll-King Splorch is repulsive and vile, but he makes up for it by being vomitous and ugly.
column5: 自由トロル王スプローチは不快で下劣な奴だが、その埋め合わせに、吐き気を催すほど醜い。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Ronnie, the Free King of the Centaurs, is a swell chap... but he's a little soft in the head.
column5: ケンタウロスの自由王ロニーは気のいい男だ……だが、少しばかり頭がゆるい。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The Wizard King Flintlok is a humorless stone-faced jerk with no tolerance for anybody else's opinions.
column5: ウィザード王フリントロックは、ユーモアのかけらもない石頭の嫌な奴で、他人の意見にはまるで耳を貸さない。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Rhegar, the DragonKing, is said to possess a shield of fantastic magical powers.
column5: ドラゴン王レイガーは、途方もない魔力を秘めた盾を持っているという。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: King Flintlok betrayed Lord Brackenthorn when he was just a child... these things have a way of coming back  around on people...
column5: フリントロック王は、まだ子供だったブラッケンソーン卿を裏切った……こういうことは、いずれ巡り巡って我が身に返ってくるものだ……

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: DragonKing Rhegar is a sexist snot... which probably means that a woman will have the honor of doing him in.
column5: ドラゴン王レイガーは女を見下す嫌な奴だ……となれば、奴にとどめを刺す栄誉は、きっと女が得ることになるだろう。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Queen Dawnstar the Sorceress prefers peace, but she's no stranger to the battlefield.  Take heed, Rhegar!
column5: ソーサレスのドーンスター女王は平和を好むが、戦場も知らぬ身ではない。気をつけろ、レイガー！

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Necromancer Lord Falat is always on the prowl for future bones...
column5: ネクロマンサー卿ファラットは、いつも骨になりそうな獲物を物色している……

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A Crusader can take out a Cyclops on Mondays, Thursdays, and Sundays.  Any other day is up for grabs.
column5: クルセイダーがサイクロプスを倒せるのは、月曜日、木曜日、日曜日だ。ほかの日は、どちらが勝つか分からない。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Peasants! snorts the knight.  "What use are they?"  The Necromancer just smiles knowingly...
column5: 「農民だと！」とナイトは鼻を鳴らした。「何の役に立つ？」ネクロマンサーは、すべてを承知したような笑みを浮かべるだけだった……

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Quint the free Lich King is said to have some fine artifacts to enhance his magical powers...
column5: 自由リッチ王クイントは、魔力を高める上等な秘宝をいくつも持っているそうだ……

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: There's a terrific island full of slow-moving monsters in the north-east... great for experience!
column5: 北東に、動きの鈍いモンスターだらけの素晴らしい島がある……経験値稼ぎにはうってつけだ！

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: You know Queen Eliza of the Medusa Island?  She's blind.  I have a feeling that she wishes she were deaf, too...
column5: メデューサ島のイライザ女王を知っているか？ 目が見えないんだ。耳も聞こえなければよかったと思っているんじゃないかな……

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The Lannisters of Casterly Rock are a bunch of backstabbing rogues and bandits.   Well, they are!
column5: キャスタリー・ロックのラニスター家は、裏切り者やならず者の集まりだ。本当にそうなんだから、仕方ない！

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The Warlock Pycelle used to be a doctor, but all he knew how to do was prescribe "Milk of the Poppy" for pain.  So, he gave it up and became a servant of darkness.
column5: ウォーロックのパイセルは、もともと医者だった。だが、痛み止めに「ケシの乳」を処方することしか知らなかった。そこで医者をやめ、闇の下僕になったのだ。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A traveler in the free islands needs to keep on his toes - there's a lot of Hideous Masks out there...
column5: 自由諸島を旅する者は気を抜けない――石仮面がごろごろしているからな……

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A Skeleton can take out a Goblin any day of the week.
column5: スケルトンは、曜日を問わずゴブリンに勝てる。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: People have the wrong impression of Liches.  Sure, they're Un-Dead, but that doesn't mean they don't have families and friends just like the rest of us.  Give a lich a break!
column5: リッチは誤解されている。確かにアンデッドだが、だからといって、俺たちと同じように家族や友人がいないわけじゃない。リッチにも、もう少し優しくしてやれ！

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Diplomacy is not all it's cracked up to be.  Sometimes, you're better off just wiping your enemies off the map.
column5: 交渉なんて、言われるほど大したものじゃない。敵は地図から消してしまったほうが早いこともある。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: When Zombies offer to join for greater glory, do you ever wonder about that?  I mean, they're Zombies, okay?  What's glory to them?
column5: ゾンビが「より大きな栄光のために」と仲間に加わりたがったら、おかしいと思わないか？ だって、ゾンビだぞ？ ゾンビにとって栄光が何だってんだ？

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A boar can take out a Black Dragon any day of the week.  If there are enough of them.  And if the dragon is already dead.
column5: 猪は、曜日を問わずブラックドラゴンに勝てる。数が十分にそろっていて、しかもドラゴンがすでに死んでいればな。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The Blood Lords have nothing better to think about than Blood.  Blood, blood, blood - that's ALL they talk about.  It gets tedious.
column5: 血の領主たちは、血のことしか頭にない。血、血、血――話すことはそれだけだ。うんざりする。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Blood Lizard, the Blood Lord of the East, has a peculiar fascination for killing minotaurs...
column5: 東の血の領主ブラッド・リザードは、ミノタウロスを殺すことに妙な執着がある……

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Medusas may be the worst singers in the world, but Mermaids are pretty close.
column5: メデューサは世界最悪の歌い手かもしれないが、人魚もそれに負けず劣らずひどい。

column3: Four lords vie for control of a forestland full of dragons and vagabonds.  Oracle tourn. version.  Re-edited by maker.
column4: Beware when travelling along the roads of the Black Forest!! An army of bandits dwell there and a boy who is barely a man leads them. His name? Eric..Erin..or something like that!
column5: 黒い森の街道を行くときは用心しろ！！ 山賊の軍勢が住み着いていて、大人になりきらない若造がそれを率いている。名前は？ エリック……エリン……そんなところだ！

column3: Four lords vie for control of a forestland full of dragons and vagabonds.  Oracle tourn. version.  Re-edited by maker.
column4: They say there are invisible mercury mines to be found in the south central regions. Invisible mercury mines indeed!! Someone's been tipping too much grog!
column5: 南中央の地方に、目に見えない水銀鉱山があるそうだ。目に見えない水銀鉱山だと！！ 誰かがグロッグ酒を飲みすぎたんだろう！

column3: Four lords vie for control of a forestland full of dragons and vagabonds.  Oracle tourn. version.  Re-edited by maker.
column4: The bones of Lord Slayer are hanging out back. They make nice windchimes!
column5: スレイヤー卿の骨は裏に吊るしてある。いい風鈴になるぞ！

column3: Four lords vie for control of a forestland full of dragons and vagabonds.  Oracle tourn. version.  Re-edited by maker.
column4: The gate of Midas lies in the center of the forest.  They also say that Bandit Lord Whatshisname guards it.
column5: ミダスの門は森の中央にある。山賊の親分の何とかいう奴が、そこを守っているそうだ。
